q: For an Axiom A attractor, SRB (Sinai–Ruelle–Bowen) measures are special because they:
opts: Maximise the KS entropy (they are measures of maximal entropy)
Are absolutely continuous on unstable manifolds and describe the statistics seen by Lebesgue-typical initial conditions
Are supported on periodic orbits only
exp: SRB measures are absolutely continuous on unstable manifolds but typically singular overall. They describe what a Lebesgue-generic observer sees: time averages for Lebesgue-a.e. initial condition converge to SRB averages (Bowen–Ruelle–Sinai).
